text:
### Bank-Initiated Closure (Special Process)  
**Characteristics:**
- Bank initiates closure (regulatory, fraud, policy)
- May be urgent or emergency scenario
- Account may be frozen  
**Actions:**
- Document closure reason in system
- Compliance/manager approval required
- Legal review (if significant financial impact)
- Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)
- Investigation documentation attached  
**Timeline:** Immediate (freeze) + 7–30 days (notice period)

raw_entities.name: Bank-Initiated Closure Process
raw_entities.description: A specialized operational workflow where the bank initiates the closure of an account due to regulatory, fraud, or policy reasons. The process may involve urgent freeze actions and requires specific approvals and notification periods ranging from immediate to 30 days.

raw_entities.name: Closure Reason Documentation
raw_entities.description: The action of recording the specific justification for the bank-initiated closure within the system.

raw_entities.name: Closure Approval Procurement
raw_entities.description: The stage where formal approval for the account closure is obtained from compliance or management.

raw_entities.name: Legal Review
raw_entities.description: A review conducted by the legal team specifically in cases where the closure is expected to have a significant financial impact.

raw_entities.name: Customer Notification
raw_entities.description: The process of notifying the customer of the closure, typically providing 30 days' notice, though this may be immediate in emergency scenarios.
context: Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)

raw_entities.name: Investigation Documentation Attachment
raw_entities.description: The finalization of the process by attaching all relevant investigation documentation to the account record.

raw_entities.name: Compliance Staff
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for providing approval for bank-initiated account closures.

raw_entities.name: Bank Manager
raw_entities.description: Role responsible for providing approval for bank-initiated account closures.

raw_entities.name: Legal Team
raw_entities.description: The team responsible for reviewing closures that may result in significant financial impact.

raw_entities.name: Financial Impact Assessment
raw_entities.description: A decision gate determining if the closure has a significant financial impact, which triggers a mandatory legal review.

raw_entities.name: Urgency/Emergency Determination
raw_entities.description: A decision point based on the nature of the closure (e.g., emergency vs standard) which determines whether the customer notice is immediate or 30 days.
context: Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)

raw_entities.name: Closure Approval Gate
raw_entities.description: The mandatory control point where approval from either compliance or a manager must be verified before the closure proceeds.

raw_entities.name: Frozen Account
raw_entities.description: An account that may be placed in a frozen state immediately during a bank-initiated closure process.

raw_entities.name: Affected Customer
raw_entities.description: The account holder who is the subject of the bank-initiated closure and must be notified.
context: Customer notice (30 days, or immediate if emergency)
